title: 航空電動致動器工程
summary: 以「由馬達軸功追到齒輪、直線行程與失效監測」為主線，在電動致動器合成命令回授工作台中依序完成馬達轉速與軸功、直線行程與作功、熱點至機殼的路徑、定位誤差與回授增益、齒隙與卡滯的殘差區別及專題交接。十單元各含機制、定量、驗證和診斷，全部算例明示為教學假設；比較情境由學員依模型建構，不是現場量測資料。
summaryEn: Follow Trace motor power through gears, linear motion and failure monitoring in a Synthetic electromechanical actuator command-feedback bench, progressing through Motor speed and shaft power, Linear stroke and work, Hotspot-to-casing thermal path, Position error and feedback gain, Residual distinction between backlash and jam, then a course handoff. Ten units each cover mechanisms, calculation, verification and diagnosis. All numbers are explicit teaching assumptions; learners construct scenario comparisons from the models, not field measurements.
scope: 公開原理支持的原創航空教學。每個數值均明示為假設模型，非同名機型實際性能、維修手冊、製造工藝、取證判據或飛行操作。任務在模型完成，不提供武器、軍用性能最佳化或真機操作指示。
scopeEn: Original aviation teaching based on public principles. Every numerical example is an explicit hypothetical model, not named-aircraft performance, maintenance data, manufacturing process, certification criterion or flight operation. Tasks run in models, excluding weapons, military-performance optimization and aircraft operating instructions.

steps.title: 馬達轉速與軸功：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Motor speed and shaft power: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 馬達轉速與軸功 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Motor speed and shaft power and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「航空電動致動器工程」中，本單元處理「馬達轉速與軸功」。軸功率為力矩乘角速度；rpm需先換成rad/s，才能與瓦特建立一致單位。
steps.instructionEn: Within Aerospace electromechanical actuators, this unit examines Motor speed and shaft power. Shaft power equals torque times angular speed; convert rpm to rad/s to obtain watts.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想台架，與其他單元尺寸及負載不可直接拼接。原創教學假設，非機型實測或操作值：力矩 τ=5 N·m、轉速 n=1800 rpm。關係式 P=τ2πn/60；含輸出單位換算的算式 5*2*pi*1800/60，結果 942.4778 W。適用範圍：固定力矩穩態，不代表馬達可在所有速度維持該力矩。
steps.observationEn: This unit uses an independent hypothetical bench; dimensions and loads must not be combined with other units without reconciliation. Original teaching assumptions, not aircraft measurements or operating settings: Torque tau=5 N m and speed n=1800 rpm. Relation P=τ2πn/60; evaluated expression including output-unit conversion 5*2*pi*1800/60 gives 942.4778 W. Applicability: Steady fixed torque; real motors cannot necessarily maintain it at every speed.
steps.failure: 在「馬達轉速與軸功」的情境中，轉速高但電流受限時，不能假設輸出力矩也不變。
steps.failureEn: In the context of Motor speed and shaft power, High speed with current limits does not imply unchanged output torque.
steps.check: 針對「馬達轉速與軸功」，用扭矩與轉速的同步時間戳計算功率，再比較單獨平均後的乘積。 保留單位、條件及原始計算，並以另一種可能原因作對照。
steps.checkEn: For Motor speed and shaft power, Compute power from synchronized torque/speed samples and compare with the product of separate averages. Retain units, conditions and raw calculations, and compare one alternative explanation.

knowledge.text: 只把 n 改為2400 rpm，其餘條件固定。用 5*2*pi*2400/60 重算，結果從 942.4778 變成 1256.6371 W。先預測方向，再記下對「馬達轉速與軸功」的意義與一項不能外推的結論。只在離線模型或紙上完成。
knowledge.textEn: Change only n to 2400 rpm, holding all other conditions fixed. Recalculate 5*2*pi*2400/60: 942.4778 becomes 1256.6371 W. Predict the direction, explain its meaning for Motor speed and shaft power, and state one conclusion that cannot be extrapolated. Work only in offline models or on paper.

steps.title: 減速比與輸出能力：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Reduction ratio and output capability: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 減速比與輸出能力 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Reduction ratio and output capability and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「航空電動致動器工程」中，本單元處理「減速比與輸出能力」。減速機交換速度與力矩，同時有能量損失；效率不能被誤用為額外能量來源。
steps.instructionEn: Within Aerospace electromechanical actuators, this unit examines Reduction ratio and output capability. A reducer trades speed for torque while losing energy; efficiency is not an additional source of power.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想台架，與其他單元尺寸及負載不可直接拼接。原創教學假設，非機型實測或操作值：馬達力矩 τm=2 N·m、減速比 G=8、效率 η=0.85。關係式 τout=τmGη；含輸出單位換算的算式 2*8*0.85，結果 13.6 N m。適用範圍：剛性定常傳動，不含齒隙、柔性與啟動慣性。
steps.observationEn: This unit uses an independent hypothetical bench; dimensions and loads must not be combined with other units without reconciliation. Original teaching assumptions, not aircraft measurements or operating settings: Motor torque tau_m=2 N m, reduction G=8 and efficiency eta=0.85. Relation τout=τmGη; evaluated expression including output-unit conversion 2*8*0.85 gives 13.6 N m. Applicability: Rigid steady transmission excluding backlash, compliance and acceleration inertia.
steps.failure: 在「減速比與輸出能力」的情境中，齒隙在反轉時造成延遲，正向穩態試驗可能完全看不出來。
steps.failureEn: In the context of Reduction ratio and output capability, Backlash produces reversal delay that a forward steady test can miss.
steps.check: 針對「減速比與輸出能力」，以輸出速度為輸入速度除以G，交叉核對前後功率差。 保留單位、條件及原始計算，並以另一種可能原因作對照。
steps.checkEn: For Reduction ratio and output capability, Use input speed divided by G for output speed and cross-check the power loss. Retain units, conditions and raw calculations, and compare one alternative explanation.
